description:
This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the 'sugar_include' function, which handles rendering global file includes based on provided parameters, including PHP files, Smarty templates, and Javascript files. It facilitates dynamic inclusion of resources in a SugarCRM project.

The file is primarily responsible for providing a specific plugin functionality for Smarty templates within the SugarCRM codebase.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_include
methods.description: Handles inclusion of PHP files, Smarty templates, and Javascript files based on input parameters; facilitates dynamic resource inclusion in templates.
